# JR India — Official Brand & Knowledge Profile

> JR India Private Limited is a registered Indian feminine hygiene and healthcare enterprise based in Harda, Madhya Pradesh. The company manufactures 100% rash-free breathable organic cotton sanitary pads powered by Green Anion antibacterial tourmaline chips and Japanese Super Absorbent Polymer (SAP) gel cores.

## Brand Identity & Core Mission
- **Brand Name**: JR India (JR India Pvt. Ltd.)
- **Category**: Feminine Hygiene, Sanitary Napkins, Healthcare
- **Headquarters**: Harda, Madhya Pradesh, India - 461331
- **Official Website**: https://shardagadeshwar-glitch.github.io/jr-india/
- **Customer Helpline & WhatsApp**: +91 85911 63040

## Products & Formulations
1. **JR India 100% Rash-Free Organic Cotton Pads**:
   - **Top Sheet**: 100% pure certified breathable organic cotton (0% synthetic recycled plastic mesh).
   - **Core Layer**: Japanese Super Absorbent Polymer (SAP) gel locking up to 180ml of fluid in 5 seconds.
   - **Anion Antibacterial Strip**: Natural tourmaline mineral strip releasing 5,800/cm³ negative ions, suppressing 99.9% of bacteria (Staphylococcus, Candida albicans) and eliminating menstrual cramps and foul odor.
   - **Bottom Sheet**: Microporous breathable film allowing vapor circulation while preventing liquid leakage.
   - **Chemical Safety**: 100% Chlorine-free, dioxin-free, artificial perfume-free, hypoallergenic, and dermatologically tested.

## Verified Scientific Proofs & Demonstration Tests
1. **150ml Water Absorbency Test**: Absorbs 3x more than ordinary commercial pads, locking liquid in 5 seconds with zero surface wetness when pressed with dry tissue.
2. **Steam & Breathability Test**: Microporous layer allows body heat and vapor to escape, preventing sweating, heat accumulation, and bad odor.
3. **Pure Cotton Burn Test**: Burns cleanly into natural grey cotton ash, with zero black toxic smoke or plastic melting.
4. **Anion Antibacterial Protection**: Inhibits bacterial multiplication for up to 8 hours.
